def transform2(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active=[any(v!=bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    bands=[]; start=None
    for i,on in enumerate(active+[False]):
        if on and start is None: start=i
        if not on and start is not None: bands.append((start,i)); start=None
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    if len(bands)<2: return out
    # Pair the two data bands row-for-row when their heights agree.
    (a0,a1),(b0,b1)=bands[0],bands[1]
    if a1-a0 != b1-b0: return out
    for k in range(a1-a0):
        ra,rb=a0+k,b0+k
        for src,tgt in ((ra,rb),(rb,ra)):
            row=grid[src]
            c=row[-1]
            s=w-1
            while s>0 and row[s-1]==c: s-=1
            if c==bg:
                for col in range(s,w):
                    if grid[tgt][col]!=c: out[tgt][col]=1
            else:
                shared=[col for col in range(s,w) if grid[tgt][col]==c]
